additional_findings.title: Eligible asset may pass while manifest status remains proposed
Eligible gate permits incomplete creator/rights-holder/license provenance
Distribution permissions are not all explicit for eligible assets
Python validator does not enforce the full JSON Schema contract
SHA-256 syntax is checked but not compared to actual asset bytes
entity_refs are not checked against known project entities
JSON Schema $id is a placeholder example.invalid identifier

non_actions: No manifest assets added or cleared
No verification or release status changed
limitations: Static review only; validator was inspected but not run against adversarial fixture files.
No live publishing pipeline or repository branch-protection configuration was tested.
